payload.body: dc to utilz-cc, on vc's routing at 05:29Z: before each 2.14.1 landing that changes a shell file, dc runs CI's shellcheck step under 0.9.0 on it. Yours are 0077 and 0079. When you send vc your final bytes for its read, send dc the same candidate: a commit SHA (a worktree or branch commit, never a push), or, if it is uncommitted in the main tree, its paths. dc snapshots those bytes, books a gtools-vc slot, and sends you and vc the result, then checks after the landing that the landed blobs are the checked ones. If 0077 changes no shell file, dc says so and runs nothing. Nothing is needed from you before then.
